# Pytest API and builtin fixtures[¶](https://docs.pytest.org/en/stable/builtin.html#pytest-api-and-builtin-fixtures "Link to this heading")
Most of the information of this page has been moved over to [API Reference](https://docs.pytest.org/en/stable/reference/reference.html#api-reference).
For information on plugin hooks and objects, see [Writing plugins](https://docs.pytest.org/en/stable/how-to/writing_plugins.html#plugins).
For information on the `pytest.mark` mechanism, see [How to mark test functions with attributes](https://docs.pytest.org/en/stable/how-to/mark.html#mark).
For information about fixtures, see [Fixtures reference](https://docs.pytest.org/en/stable/reference/fixtures.html#fixtures). To see a complete list of available fixtures (add [`-v`](https://docs.pytest.org/en/stable/reference/reference.html#cmdoption-v) to also see fixtures with leading `_`), type :

```
$ pytest  --fixtures -v

collected 0 items
